title: GLUTTONY — THE RAVENOUS
author: Jester / Arkham
content:
Ha ha ha! You want to know about the third circle? The Gluttons eat everything — power, life, potential. They can't stop. They were born without a limit.

I should know. I spent years consuming knowledge that wasn't mine, absorbing demon texts until my body started to change. A small price. A very small price for what I was building.

Dante's brother understood what it meant to want everything. The difference is Vergil wanted power for its own sake. I wanted it for a purpose. That makes me the sane one. Doesn't it? Ha.
